Final Host projection preserves complete current-Match confirmed equipment, multiplicity and empty/unknown semantics. The shared read-only calculate tool exposes explicit Core roster construction in all coaching modes, with captured snapshot guards and no natural-language intent gate; theoretical coverage is not Ranking strength or verified emblem-holder legality.

A genuinely empty successful Codex coach completion can continue once on the same owned task/session with remaining budget. This transport recovery is not a format correction and cannot replay bootstrap, commentary, tool actions, cancelled owners or failed provider requests; host-context-lifecycle-contract owns the policy.

The 2026-09-16 review remediation preserves native-session initialization and cancellation ownership, process-instance cleanup, per-window equipment choices, source-bound relation retrieval, pre-truncation fit scoring, active augment effects, and explicit equipment multiplicity/unknown/empty semantics across Runtime and Renderer.
Registry entries are the authority classification for requirement-like docs.
Legacy JSON is mirror/debug evidence only; daemon SQLite app.sqlite is the canonical runtime state store.
Historical, paused, and generated docs may support navigation but cannot override current requirement contracts.
AGENTS.md and repo-local skills are discovery and authoring entrypoints, not fallback product authorities.
Approved 2026-07-29 UI and runtime-mode decisions are current only when represented in the registered machine contracts, not in entrypoint prose alone.
Structured choice discovery now uses exact-stage default browsing plus explicitly labelled full-catalog typed search; visual icon manifests are not gameplay-stage authority.
Augment category filters are catalog-driven patch metadata: Common UI renders the active catalog's categories, combines them with stage and tier, and never embeds one season's labels.

Season companion lineup tools declare product-supported source variables and branches, discard unsupported branches, preserve retained candidate rows atomically, and publish a small descriptor plus bounded hash-addressed shards; source candidate and repeated slot counts are diagnostics, not distinct final recommendation or entity counts.
Windows desktop entry and installer shortcut behavior is governed by the distribution contract; a development shortcut must never be shipped as the player shortcut.
Hard-data content manifests are deterministic and path-relative; flat lookup indexes and bounded live acceptance replace retired hot-shard and permanent machine-local evidence gates.

Lightweight semantic features remain a closed supporting layer distributed across Common, Core, Ranking, and Runtime ownership; they are not a fifth pipeline or a substitute for typed facts and the registered five-component score.

Augment choice is a separate three-candidate decision evaluator, not another lineup score: Core owns static semantic profiles, Runtime derives current realization and top-four/first-place objective fit, Ranking contributes deduplicated association evidence from a baseline that excludes augment_fit, and the Host remains the final explanation owner.

The Strategy Evidence Kernel is the shared Common/Runtime retrieval contract for direct questions, structured cards, and proactive Cruise. Runtime binds one immutable evidence snapshot, multi-route plan, source policy, keyed prefetch evidence, coverage receipt, and bounded typed tools; the Host Agent plans and answers inside the same logical turn without a separate planning-model call. Satisfied evidence must be present on the wire or available through a verified thread/turn/Match/Core/task-bound read-only tool.

AI-native Host execution loads one complete deduplicated Agent-readable Common view per provider session, then supplies a full Mode contract and checkpoint Action Brief per real turn. Runtime performs authority, permission, lifecycle, typed retrieval, scoring evidence, and deterministic materialization; the Host owns semantic judgment. Format and quality diagnostics never trigger a second Provider turn or suppress independently readable strategy text.

authority_domains.change_policy: Every user interaction has at most one strategy-answer owner. Ordinary chat may update intent and provisional target context but never writes choice candidates or final selections; those are canonical only through the active structured card. Derived intent, target-plan facts, explicit equipment reports, manual match-variable confirmations, and final choice confirmations update selected context without opening sibling response tasks. The next user-owned advice or fixed strategic checkpoint absorbs still-material opening-variable and confirmed-choice context. Every augment preselection answer at every registered augment checkpoint must provide both candidate ranking and one explicit machine-valid keep/refresh action. An equipment reply may still use its one direct answer to decide slam/wait/holder from the newly recorded facts. Choice cards expose one unified advice action that reads all reliable canonical context while keeping output focused on the current choice; missing equipment cannot block it. Explicit structured-card advice retains one card-mode response owner until terminal delivery ACK; choice-window reservation, proactive expiry, punctuation-only status checks, and semantic observation cannot replace or duplicate that owner. Final confirmation is state-only, returns response_task null, and is idempotent. Candidate-bearing card submissions require the current canonical report revision and cannot overwrite a newer choice set. Only final confirmation may rebase a stale binding inside the same active match, stage, and choice kind, and only when exact slot plus candidate ref/name still matches the canonical set. Fact-only equipment writes ignore missing or stale surrounding card bindings. Renderer confirmation success follows canonical persistence; explicit advice success additionally requires its concrete response-task id. Persistent provider turns must be cancellable from queue admission through native execution without closing the owning session or sending a cancelled queued turn later. Host response timeout starts from actual provider-awaiting time, not earlier task preparation. Artifact filenames derived from response identities must be Windows-safe and collision-resistant. Provisional target intent may inform later decisions without silently becoming a durable plan. Valid provider output is delivered once, transport diagnostics never become a second answer, cancellation targets the active task, and internal validator text is not player-visible.

authority_domains.app_restart_policy: New app launch or daemon replacement retires old Match state and work and bootstraps a fresh lobby session regardless of prior clean shutdown. Same-app renderer reload reuses ownership; provider-only recovery is limited to the same live app and daemon.
authority_domains.change_policy: Use provider-native conversations, not a JCC transcript/session replacement. Keep one live lobby provider process/session until app exit or explicit New Conversation and one live match provider process/session per Start Match. Ordinary turns reuse the owning live session and never resume it; resume/load is crash-recovery only. Provider, command, launch arguments, version, and provider-home isolation own transport identity; changing only model or reasoning applies to subsequent turns inside the same native conversation. The provider owns chat history and native context compaction. A Runtime Daemon cold start or replacement restart gets a 300000ms final abnormal-start guard because ready is published only after module loading, writer-lease acquisition, SQLite restoration, and Active Ranking reconciliation; actual readiness returns immediately, while deterministic startup errors still fail immediately. Separate Runtime-only request metadata, one complete deduplicated Agent-readable Common static capsule capped at 256 KiB, and a current-turn delta with a 1 MiB ordinary target and 2 MiB ordinary ceiling; strategic turns use a 4 MiB target and 8 MiB ceiling, while context-only manual-variable turns use a 16 KiB persistent optimization target. Reserve native-tool evidence adaptively from the evidence plan and protected candidate count. Every Host turn receives its complete Mode contract and checkpoint Action Brief and is projected from current Runtime-owned facts; prior materialized Host requests are never used as evidence input. Provider transport accepts parseable aliases and optional fields. Runtime locally normalizes equivalent fields, records soft quality diagnostics without another Provider turn, and delivers independently readable text immediately; only authority, permission, transport recovery, and cross-candidate authoritative composition are hard boundaries. Production selects pending advice requests in process, recursively sanitizes nested Host payloads before every canonical transition, persists metadata-only request references, and sends only the current resolved decision snapshot plus typed current-day evidence; it never copies full hard data, raw rankings, or complete request events through child-process stdout. Diagnostics are default-off, bounded, asynchronous, and unable to delay answer delivery. Mode selection is a bounded control-plane mutation: it does not build context, start visual sensing, or cancel an owned Host turn, and late renderer responses cannot overwrite the newest selected mode. Start Match creates a fresh canonical match identity, retires all prior match-scoped state, and must confirm the old provider and watcher process trees have stopped before publishing the replacement watcher workspace or starting replacement children; an unconfirmed stop produces a degraded retryable boundary rather than a second owner. Stop Answer interrupts only the active turn and preserves mode/transport; an accepted but unsettled cancellation keeps the same canonical task id and targetable native handle until settlement. Legacy JSON mirrors never hydrate SQLite. Stop Match preempts an unfinished match-provider bootstrap before serialized cleanup, closes only the match route, retires queued OCR and match work, and confirms both provider and watcher termination before clean completion. Match retirement preserves preferences, strategy memory, Wiki, lobby conversation, device connection, data packages, and at most 20 compact postgame summaries. A developer-only retired-version cleanup may explicitly remove every prior match summary, transient task/event/log row, stale Wiki curation run/source event, generated diagnostic, calibration capture, and compatibility match mirror only when an explicit season id resolves to a valid registered archive manifest and is neither the active nor candidate season. The DB reset writes an archive-bound receipt, and local-artifact pruning requires the matching same-season receipt. Cleanup must preserve published Wiki pages, user preferences and memory, the daily session, provider-native history, Core Profiles, rankings, source archives, plans, and dependencies. Clean Exit attempts all owned-resource cleanup even when one child fails, invalidates the active match route, and must never resume that match on the next launch.

Expose only user settings backed by real product behavior or source partitions. Default rank preference to Master and above, normalize historical aliases before Host context selection, and never invent a Challenger-only data partition. Keep the default-off fault-diagnostic switch separate from strategy semantics; when enabled it retains only bounded seven-day evidence and cannot block Runtime actions or Host answer delivery. Request-scoped evidence capabilities are typed UI metadata, never natural-language inference. The Cruise active_core_profile_only action bypasses direct and derived ranking/Wiki retrieval, scoring, cached strategy packets, and rank-derived proactive obligations while preserving Common, the captured Core Profile, reliable current facts, explicit user input, and deterministic calculation results. The separate popular_recipe_catalog_only action reads only the exact recipe generation captured at Start Match and strips live state, national strength, winning recipes, hero-ranking evidence, Wiki, Core theorycraft, and Cruise scoring; it must disclose that returned templates have no strength authority.

Continuously commit trusted facts into canonical state and immutable latest decision snapshots without giving raw changes speaking rights. Only the registered fixed strategic checkpoints or an explicit user/card action may open the Host answer lane; ordinary economy, shop, board, bench, HP, equipment, emergency, pivot, and delivery-recovery events are fact-only evidence and cannot create competing automatic answers. The fixed strategy blocks are lineup direction and commitment, formation readiness and execution, and cap/floor endgame. The 2-2 checkpoint owns the one complete stage-two exploration contract; 2-5 is recovery-only and remains silent after a complete 2-2 delivery; 2-7 prepares the 3-2 choice. Later checkpoints absorb unresolved earlier obligations from the same block, recompute from the newest facts, and preserve every required field rather than replaying old wording. Direct user intent and structured choice confirmations may temporarily own the visible lane but cannot close an undelivered strategic obligation. Missing stage blocks new obligations but does not erase an existing one. Complete Master+ candidate identities and rosters survive scoring, compaction, retry, and delivery; the Host compares complete candidates and never builds a direction by joining a Ranking trait label to unrelated board units. The Cruise UI action `确认最终阵容：` explicitly requests one complete final target and preserves the user's following natural-language identity. That target may resolve to an existing Ranking candidate, a lineup established through chat, or a user-custom lineup; non-candidate targets require an explicit target source and identity, and no path may substitute the current partial board or silently merge candidates. At 4-3 one complete standard, winning, popular, or user-custom target identity is locked, and later formation or cap advice cannot silently merge another lineup's members, equipment, or cap path. Board and bench remain low-weight realization evidence in stage two; current Core, Ranking strength, confirmed augments, and equipment retain their registered precedence. Every successful HUD run emits compact per-field observed/missing audit evidence so unreliable HP or board capture becomes conditional evidence rather than fabricated certainty.
authority_domains.current_decision_addendum: A direct user or explicit structured-card answer remains the one visible owner and absorbs any pending fixed-checkpoint obligation by recomputing it from the latest verifiable stage. Successful delivery closes only the exact absorbed obligation; failure, cancellation, timeout, invalid delivery, or Renderer ACK loss keeps it retryable. The 2-2 complete-candidate contract must be delivered once even when first completed at 2-5 or absorbed by a later same-block checkpoint. At 3-3 candidates narrow but retain complete identity; at 3-5 and 3-7 execution advice references those identities; at 3-7 it also reviews four-stage equipment continuity and transition replacement order; at 4-3 final confirmation repeats the complete chosen roster; at 4-5 formation readiness is rechecked; stages 5 and 6 discuss floor, cap, levels, quality, replacements, positioning, and equipment continuity only inside the locked target. Lineup fit uses the registered exact stage profiles and treats explicit target role as a constraint rather than a hidden sixth weight. Typed indexes annotate the eligible Master+ pool without replacing the five-component score. Cruise and direct strategy questions share one Runtime-owned integrated decision snapshot expressed through the Common vocabulary; supporting evaluators cannot own sibling answers.

Winning recipes are primary structural enrichment and allowlisted official popular recipes are secondary; neither may create, replace, merge, or statistically rescore the Master+ standard roster. Record Ranking, winning-recipe, and popular-recipe dates independently. Same-day sources are fresh; 1-2-day lag remains normal structural evidence; 3-7-day lag requires exact or high-confidence compatible matching; older sources are diagnostic only; incompatible Core, season, or patch is forbidden. Daily update prepares deterministic data, runs semantic maintenance for changed or missing annotations with a one-hour end-to-end default and bounded three-minute Host calls, validates all batch hashes, closes Ranking and recipe pointers atomically, and publishes only when Runtime mirrors resolve the same identities. After a successful publication, automatically prune generated stores while retaining two finalized Previous versions by default; a prepared generation without completed semantic maintenance does not consume a Previous slot, and cleanup failure is diagnostic rather than a rollback of the committed Active closure. An incomplete run preserves the previous Active closure and exact-input checkpoints; Host failure cannot silently mark maintenance ready. Start Match and Lobby resolve only the active closure at a turn boundary. Typed intent, full-pool evaluation, role constraints, five-component stage scoring, pagination, complete candidate identities, atomic variants, and target relevance remain authoritative; budget compaction removes diagnostics before complete roster, identity, variant, recipe-freshness, or lifecycle evidence.
authority_domains.current_decision_addendum: Runtime presentation groups close atomic Master+ variants by current-Core primary trait, canonical roster overlap, and main carry without merging independent strength or identities. Generic lobby directions prefer five distinct S/A representatives with at most two per family; explicit S/A/B/C/D, candidate, or variant requests retain exact retrieval. Match working-set diversity remains downstream of full-pool eligibility and the unchanged registered five-component stage score. At 3-3 an ordinary confirmed augment, item, or owned core unit may justify a new exact direction, subject to durable target authority.
